content:
devin: Quick sync — infra + runtime handoff for new KV/prefix cache metrics. We need a short playbook for oncall and dashboards.

maria: Agree. Top priorities: hit rate, eviction rate, reuse_by_workload (per-tenant), and cold-warm transitions.

aaron: For reuse_by_workload do we want tags: model, route, tenant? I'd push model+route as first-class. tenant is heavy but useful.

jen: model+route + bucketed sequence length. reuse behaves very differently for long-seq requests.

devin: Good call. Ops wants an SLA signal: if prefix_hit_rate < 60% for 5m AND eviction_rate > baseline => page.

ops-bot: FYI: paging threshold must be a boolean alert. Ops prefers sensitivity over noise for cache regressions.

maria: Suggested metric names (promql-friendly): kv_cache_request_total, kv_cache_hit_total, kv_cache_eviction_total, kv_prefix_reuse_by_model_sum, kv_prefix_reuse_by_route_sum.

aaron: +1 but add kv_cache_warm_seconds to track how long entries stay hot. Might help root cause.

jen: For dashboards: overview (global hit/eviction), breakdown by model/route, heatmap of tenant reuse percentiles, and timeline of recent evictions with correlated deploys.

devin: Can infra emit tags as labels: model="<model>", route="<route>", tenant="<tenant|unassigned>", seq_bucket="<<=128|129-512|>512>"? That will keep queries manageable.

maria: Yes. Implementation note: runtime will sample tenant label for high-cardinality routes — default tenant="sampled" to avoid prometheus blowup. Document sampling policy.

aaron: How about rollouts UX? product wants a single toggle: "enable cache telemetry" per deployment that flips label emission.

jen: We should gate sensitive tenant labels behind private deploy only. Hosted customers we sample or hash-prefix.

devin: Action items: 1) runtime: emit metrics + labels as discussed (owner: jen) 2) infra/metrics: create recording rules and dashboard skeleton (owner: aaron) 3) ops: define alert runbook and thresholds (owner: maria). Due EOD Thu.

maria: I'll draft the runbook, include quick mitigations: bump cache size, temporary routing to fallback model variant, and forced cache warm (prefetch job).

aaron: I'll push dashboard PR with sample queries:

```
# hit rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total[5m]))

# eviction rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_eviction_total[1m]))
```

jen: I'll open runtime PR for labels and add a feature flag. Will add unit tests for metrics emission.

devin: Nice. If anyone wants to pair on the dashboard queries ping me. I'll also append a short note for the console UX team about showing tenant-sampled warnings.

maria: Thanks — tagging @sachin for SRE review on paging thresholds.

**End of thread**
